latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of nutrient-openclaw – OpenClaw-native document processing skill for Nutrient DWS.

- Provides native OpenClaw triggers for PDF conversion, OCR, text/table extraction, PII redaction, watermarking, digital signing, and credit checks via nutrient_* tools.
- Processes files over the network using Nutrient DWS; built for OpenClaw users with easy installation and API key setup.
- Offers extensive documentation on data handling, security, and privacy.
- Includes a comprehensive set of document processing tools available directly within OpenClaw conversations.
